failure_policy: Stop and preserve on the first failure. No automatic restart, replay, row filtering, roster, role-graph, prompt, knowledge, geometry or cap change. AT MOST ONE root-diagnosed recovery re-registration for this run, and a second failure closes this cell: no third registration, and the fix must be proven on a four-row dry run before another mechanism is admitted. RESUME-RECOVERY CLAUSE (owner decision 22 of 2026-09-18): if the abort is an INFRASTRUCTURE failure with code and request bytes unchanged, the one recovery takes the resume-recovery form of harness item E10 -- the same run id, a fresh attempt id, a resume_from declaration naming the predecessor attempt and its trace SHA-256, every COMPLETE row kept without selection under invariant I7r, every partial or unstarted row re-flown in full, no change to the question, roster, comparator, decision rule or caps, and the run-cumulative budget re-checked; otherwise the one recovery is a full re-fly. A partial manifest is never scored and never read.
